prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit castle courtyard with a worn cobblestone floor, a standard-height arched gate, low stone steps and a waist-high well edge, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Egyptian man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, smooth warm light-brown skin, a playful half-grin, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold ship's anchor, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a copper barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a silver square-sided cowbell, a tin small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold hair ornaments. Extremely long almond nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black police cap with a silver badge, a thin black leather chest harness carrying a silver badge, steel handcuffs hanging from one hip string, and a minimal black leather T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink platform stiletto Mary Janes, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Argentinian man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, smooth light-olive skin, a playful half-grin, bold vivid tangerine-orange hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large bronze hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a bronze teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three silver anklets. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a thin golden halo floating above his head, a pair of large white feathered angel wings attached at his back, and a minimal white leopard-print satin with gold leopard-print trim T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
